Make a Jump roll: if failed, you fall and lose 1D3 hit points. 
Either way, you’re in section-N. Stairs lead down to 328, or you 
can try a Climb roll to return to the corridor at 394 (you may 
try one Climb roll per half hour, and you must succeed to reach 
that level).
